answerability.answerable_part: Whether reported motorist deaths per 1,000 police-reported NYC crashes changed from 2013 to 2025.
answerability.unanswerable_part: Whether the risk per mile driven declined; crash counts are not miles driven or motorist exposure.

metric: Annual number_of_motorist_killed divided by annual number of crash records, multiplied by 1,000
denominator: All police-reported NYC crash records in that calendar year
population: All police-reported NYC crash records with a usable crash_date in 2013–2025; numerator is the summed motorist deaths among those crashes and denominator is the number of those crash records.
data_check_interpretation: The selected population has 2,132,218 crash records across 2013–2025, with records in each year and observed crash dates spanning January 1 through December 31 in every year. number_of_motorist_killed is NULL in 0 rows and negative in 0 rows; zero occurs in 2,130,945 rows in total and is a valid no-motorist-death value. No rows are excluded for the field; all records, including zero-death crashes, remain in the denominator. The date bounds indicate full calendar-year bounds in each target year, though they do not independently establish reporting completeness.
decisions: Keep all crash records in the planned years; include zero values in the numerator as zero and retain their crashes in the denominator. No other rows are dropped.
limitations: Deaths per 1,000 crash reports adjusts for changes in crash-record volume, not miles driven or motorist exposure; it is not per-mile risk. The file contains no miles-driven denominator. Check of observed date bounds indicates full calendar-year bounds for every year, but does not independently establish reporting completeness.
